mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park and a beautiful waxing crescent moon visible tonight.

The Verona Senior Center is currently seeking volunteers. You can help out at least twice a month, though please note some roles involve physical activity like standing or lifting. You must maintain participant confidentiality, and background checks are required for unsupervised roles. Forms are available at the front desk.

Today is packed with fun, including the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.
On Wednesday, August 6, the Verona Police Department arrested a 49-year-old man for a fourth O W I offence after an officer observed him driving erratically.
The delicious flavor of the day is Turtle. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM today.
